result:
All three test classes compiled successfully:

- `tests/org/apache/commons/cli2/WriteableCommandLineAgentTest.java` — exercises the 11 methods declared directly on the `WriteableCommandLine` interface (addOption, addValue, addProperty×2, addSwitch, getCurrentOption/setCurrentOption, getUndefaultedValues, looksLikeOption, setDefaultSwitch, setDefaultValues), including the documented `IllegalStateException` on double `addSwitch`.
- `tests/org/apache/commons/cli2/commandline/WriteableCommandLineImplAgentTest.java` — covers every concretely-documented method on `WriteableCommandLineImpl` (constructor, options/properties/switches/values round trips, `getValues` default-fallback vs. added-value precedence, `toString`/`getNormalised` non-null contracts, etc.).
- `tests/org/apache/commons/cli2/option/GroupImplAgentTest.java` — covers the constructor and all documented `GroupImpl` methods, including boundary/error cases (`validate()` throwing `OptionException` when the minimum-members constraint isn't met vs. succeeding when minimum is 0, `findOption` returning `null` for unknown triggers, `canProcess` returning `false` for unrelated input, null-name construction).

All fixtures are self-contained inside each file — `GroupImpl` (the only documented, instantiable `Option`) is reused as the stand-in `Option`/`Group` fixture everywhere, so no test class depends on another. `./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
